Frequently asked questions

Which devices can I use?

Supported devices include Smart TVs, Android, Apple mobile devices, Firestick, Windows, MAG and Enigma2. See our guides for player-specific setup.

How do I get help with setup?

Message our support team on WhatsApp and we will guide you through the setup steps for your player.

What does a reseller credit cover?

Each credit represents 12 months and can be used through the reseller panel to create or renew a customer line.
